title: New IUIC Outro
segments: Across the earth, the prophets move.
From city streets to distant lands, the
message is the same.
Israel must rise. Through every quest,
every journey, the truth spreads.
No border can contain it. No distance
can silence it. Our nation lives in
every moment. In joy, we celebrate
marriages. In sorrow, we honor our dead.
On the Sabbath, we gather as one.
Families rejoicing together, bound by
the commandments of God. Yet are we
tried. From the stones of Kenya to the
hatred in Montana, we endure as a
soldier of the Lord.
And still the mission expands on the
airwaves, on the screens, in every
nation under heaven. Israel's voice is
heard.
We build our communities. We raise our
children in royalty.
We restore what was broken. We clean
what was defiled.
We show the world who we are.
This is Israel United with Christ.
Nation in motion. Nation endures.
